designs.name: with_memory v2 — PACK+EPOCH (working-set pack + opportunistic micro-epoch rebasing on an externalized ledger)
designs.one_liner: Kill the measured dominant cost (F4 cold re-exploration) with a mechanically-curated, fresh-from-disk working-set pack on the proven always-cold loop, then layer short warm micro-epochs (K<=5, est_ctx<=150k, mandatory cold cut before refactor turns) only where live thread counters prove warm is cheaper — memory (ledger + guard + verify-gate) always lives OUTSIDE the thread, so a cut costs one seed injection, never knowledge.

designs.name: Guarded Warm Epochs (with_memory v2)
designs.one_liner: Treat the warm codex thread as a disposable prompt-cache vehicle and the contract ledger as the only durable memory: run guard+gate-protected turns inside budget-bounded `codex exec resume` epochs, with delta-only memory injection per turn, and let the SLM cut-and-reseed the thread BEFORE compaction, before dangerous refactors, and on verify-red drift.

designs.name: Risk-Gated Epoch Rebasing (with_memory v2)
designs.one_liner: Warm codex threads become a revocable privilege granted only to low-risk turns: every contract-endangering turn (refactor, guard-hit, repair) executes in the validated cold-loop regime with full ledger+guard injection, epoch cuts are gated on a green verify sweep, and contracts are enforced by actually running their locking tests — so the token optimization can degrade only into the configuration that already went 3/3.

designs.name: Epoch Sessions (`--memory epoch`) — budget-bounded warm-thread epochs rebased onto the contract ledger
designs.one_liner: Run genuinely warm native threads (the only cache that works on codex, per F2) in short deterministic epochs, cut BEFORE compaction/danger, and rebase each new epoch onto the shipped ledger plus a once-per-epoch seed pack — warm-cache economics inside an epoch, the cold loop's correctness machinery (guard + verify-gate + fresh-eyes rebase) at every boundary.

designs.name: with_memory v2 — Ledger-Rebased Epochs (harness arm: `epoch_rebase`)
designs.one_liner: Run codex WARM inside short, deterministically-bounded epochs to harvest the only cache codex gives us (F2), and make the CUT — not paging — the eviction primitive: rebase to a fresh thread seeded once per epoch with a tombstoned contract ledger + a budgeted hot-file pack, with refactor turns force-rebased onto a clean head and the pytest verify-gate escalating warm-retry → rebase-retry.

changes_made_from_redteam: A1/A4/A5/A7: Added STAGE 0 — a zero-token offline mining-and-simulation pass over the F1 artifacts already on disk, as a hard build-gate before any epoch code: (a) decompose cold-turn uncached into pack-displaceable re-exploration vs residual warmth-addressable cost; (b) replay the EpochPolicy triggers against the F1 per-turn logs (guard_hits, retries, refactor class, gate outcomes are all logged) with a pre-registered build gate: simulated mean epoch length >=3 warm turns AND warm fraction >=40%, else Stage C is cancelled without writing epoch.py; (c) extract the warm total-vs-ctx curve and max observed single-turn thread growth from the F1 warm runs' cumulative counters (open question #4 promoted to a gate); (d) kill-before-build criterion: projected residual warm saving x simulated warm-turn count must exceed probe + experiment spend.

A2/A8: Seed-cache probe re-scoped to production pacing: inserts the measured real inter-turn latency (gate pytest + SLM calls + median turn wall) between probe turns, maps a cache-retention TTL curve at 2/5/10/20-minute gaps, adds a thread-longevity leg (resume the same thread after 5/15/30/60 min), and measures warm marginal-uncached against a PACK-COLD turn, not a bare cold turn. Added gap-aware policy rule: elapsed-since-last-warm-turn > measured TTL => cut (cut_reason=ttl_expired). Stage A's added gate seconds are measured and fed into the probe's pacing.

A3: Warm pack refresh excludes files whose hash change was caused by the thread's OWN edits (provenance tracked from file_change/changed-file events the harness already records); externally-changed files inject hunk-level diffs vs the last-injected hash when smaller than the excerpt; warm injected overhead re-priced from per-turn changed-file statistics in the F1 logs BEFORE the Stage C gate is registered.

A4/A7: The 150k ceiling is demoted from a constant to a Stage-0-calibrated value: ceiling = min(total-optimal point on the measured warm total-vs-ctx curve weighted by quota semantics, measured cliff − max observed single-turn growth − 20k margin) — expected ~100-120k; k default lowered to 4. The compaction cliff and event signature are re-measured per pinned codex version in the N=2 mechanics smoke. The F8 quota-drain probe moves BEFORE Stage C build (its result can zero the epoch rationale). Expected quarantine losses are budgeted into the Stage C experiment cost.

A6: Stage B/C acceptance gates rebuilt with noise margins from a variance estimate over the existing N=5 artifacts (chain_auth v2, compaction N=5): decision rule = point estimate AND 90% CI upper bound clear the threshold; STRONG PASS (total <=0.80x, uncached <=0.90x) => pack accepted and the epoch track proceeds; MARGINAL band (total 0.80-0.90x with green parity) has a PRE-DECLARED outcome — pack ships opt-in, epoch track closes; single pre-committed N-bump (to N=7) allowed once on the decisive metric only. Removes the re-run temptation on edge results.

A9/A27: The Stage-B displacement kill-gate is re-based from tool-call COUNT to exploration-BYTES: first-feed tool-output tokens per turn, parsed from the saved --json streams, -30% pre-registered. The full item.completed type histogram is logged per turn so schema drift is visible; tool_calls is demoted to mechanism corroboration. A 1-run pack pilot (~5% of experiment cost) runs before committing the N=5x2 spend.

A10: Tombstone/UNLOCKED rendering gets its own separate 400-char cap (most-recent-first) so it can never displace active contracts inside STATE_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS; UNLOCKED renders as a one-char marker; a unit test asserts active contracts survive rendering at MAX_CONTRACTS with a full tombstone section (the PR#44 trailing-truncation bug class); rendered-prefix tokens are logged per turn in Stage B as a measured line item.

A11: extra_targets are NEVER mixed into the base gate invocation: candidates are pre-validated with one batched `pytest --collect-only -q --continue-on-collection-errors` call, unresolvable node-ids dropped and counted (UNRESOLVED rate logged per turn), survivors run as a SECOND pytest invocation so a targeting failure can never mask a base-scope red; rc=4 maps to 'targeting-invalid' — a tri-state that is never red (no retry burn), never green, and never skips the base scope. Stage A acceptance adds a fixture arm with deliberately corrupted/hallucinated ledger `tests` (gate must degrade to base scope, not to skip) and promotes UNRESOLVED+UNLOCKED rates to acceptance criteria.

A12: Deprecate ops hardened on three axes: (1) require deterministic removal intent in the USER prompt/spec (raw prompt or spec.intent matches an explicit removal instruction; agent-initiated removals — including confident DONE narration — can never deprecate); (2) one-turn quarantine: the op takes effect only after the NEXT gate-green turn and the contract still guard-fires during quarantine; (3) if the deprecating turn deleted rather than migrated the contract's locking tests (checked against the pre-turn snapshot_ledger), scoped green is insufficient — full-suite green is required. The eviction self-contradiction is resolved: tombstones compress to a names-only do-not-resurrect list EXEMPT from MAX_CONTRACTS, so they are never evicted and never displace actives.

A13/A5: The 'cuts are free' claim is withdrawn and repaired: the ledger gains a bounded 'unfinished' WIP key ([{task, remaining, hazards}], emitted by the SAME per-turn nano call as a second JSON key, OVERWRITTEN not merged each turn, injected only on seed turns) so cut-destroyed in-flight plan state is distilled; non-forced cuts (ceiling, k_max) prefer turns whose gate is green AND whose distillation reported nothing unfinished; the Stage C fixture adds an explicit 3-turn dependent task spanning a forced cut, scored on end-state; the seed injection premium and the post-cut cold-turn re-exploration bump are explicitly priced in the token model instead of assumed zero.

A14: Ledger ordering fixed at both holes: (a) on any turn where a verify retry ran, update_ledger runs AFTER the retry loop with the LAST retry's transcript + post-retry changed files (one extra nano call, repair turns only), with a Stage-A unit test asserting 'ledger reflects the post-repair tree'; the cold_repair cut encodes re-distill-before-reseed in the EpochPolicy state machine, not in hook ordering; (b) censored/timed-out turns replace the silent distillation skip with a mechanical no-SLM degraded record: git-diff-derived provisional contract stubs (names/kwargs added or removed) flagged provisional, plus a 'ledger stale as of turn N' marker surfaced in the next seed's prompt.

A15/A17: Epoch risk gate hardened to the cheapest safe default: guard_hits >= 1 forces cold, unconditionally — and guard_hits for the epoch gate is computed with impacted-files UNIONED with the epoch's cumulative changed-file set, so referential warm turns ('now do the same for the async client') inherit the epoch's file scope and fire correctly. A DESTRUCTIVE_KW list (remove, delete, drop, deprecate, retire, strip, prune, clean up) is checked for the epoch risk gate only (guard-fire behavior unchanged), closing the REFACTOR_KW hole. Consequence: warm turns have guard silence BY CONSTRUCTION, so the only destructive regime ever exercised is the measured one — cold agent, full guard front-placed (the 0/10 pair); any warm turn observed with guard_hits>=1 is logged as a policy bug, asserted zero in Stage C.

A16: Gate verdict is an explicit tri-state in EpochPolicy — green / red / NO-SIGNAL (skip, rc=5, timeout, targeting-invalid): NO-SIGNAL never satisfies stay-warm and never satisfies the tombstone gate-green condition; a skipped-gate turn with nonempty git-modified files forces cut_reason=unverified_edit; after ANY warm turn, a deterministic _git_modified_files check overrides the SLM route — modified files + non-editing route => the gate runs anyway. NO-SIGNAL counts are reported per run.

A17: Warm delta injection never deltas the compact state: the full ledger_state_summary (<=1.8k chars) rides in EVERY warm message; only pack excerpts and full contract bodies are delta'd via the seen-set. Stage C instrumentation adds a per-epoch-position correctness readout (contract regressions by position-in-epoch) parallel to the per-position uncached curve.

A18: Added a per-version SEMANTICS CALIBRATION probe (2 turns: seed with a known-large turn, resume with 'reply ok'; cumulative semantics => reading2 ~= reading1 + full context, per-invocation => reading2 ~= reading1 + epsilon) run before any epoch arm and after any detected version change — a deterministic distinguisher the monotonicity check structurally cannot be. `codex --version` equality is ENFORCED before every run (hard abort on mismatch, like QuotaExhausted, never a silent fallback); the calibrated semantics fingerprint is stamped into summary.json and aggregate_runs refuses to compute Stage C gates over runs with mixed fingerprints.

A19: Warmth is evidence, not intent: every warm-labeled turn must show (a) the stream's thread_id equal to the intended resume target and (b) cached_tokens above the ~5k codex-preamble floor (F2 magnitude); mismatch => mode_mismatch flag + forced cut + run-level quarantine counter. The N=2 mechanics smoke must contain >=1 evidence-verified resume before paid spend; the paired within-run statistic conditions on evidence-verified warm turns only; 'mode_mismatch_rate = 0' is added to Stage C acceptance criteria so thread.started schema drift fails loudly.

A20: Post-timeout QUARANTINE: after any codex rc=124, enumerate and kill orphan codex process trees (porting the reap_claude_orphans pattern to codex) and poll the thread's rollout-file mtime + process table until quiet (bounded wait) BEFORE pack build, gate run, ledger update, or next-turn launch. A thread whose last turn timed out is NEVER resumed (hard rule, cut_reason=timeout_orphan). orphan_detected is logged per turn and contaminated turns are dropped from the paired statistic.

A21: Fail-closed availability rules: (1) SLM-unavailable or normalizer-failed turn => classified RISKY => runs cold with the full guard (absence of signal never reads as absence of risk — this also covers keyword-free destructive prompts arriving with no spec); (2) any ledger_ok=False streak suppresses all non-mandatory cuts (only hard ceiling + compaction tripwire + timeout_orphan remain) and every forced cut during degradation appends a MECHANICAL fallback record (raw prompt + changed-files list, no SLM) so continuity degrades to recency, not to nothing; ledger_degraded_turns is surfaced per run and 'ledger_ok on >=12/13 turns' becomes a run-validity criterion (invalid runs excluded from N, never averaged in).

A22/A8: Run-level circuit breaker: 2 consecutive zero-token or rc!=0 turns => abort the run with a distinct exception and mark it INVALID (never complete-and-counted); ~/.codex/config.toml is content-hashed at run start and re-verified at every epoch cut and before every warm turn (a file stat — free), mismatch => abort + re-check for the desktop-app service_tier clobber. Product side: epochs are self-disabling — the first resume_failed sets a sticky per-session epochs_off flag announced on stderr and in --json (no reseed-thrash); --epochs documented as requiring a persistent ~/.codex (not ephemeral CI).

A23: The ledger and epoch sidecars gain a PID-lease lockfile + generation counter: on write, the loaded generation must still be current; on contention or a live foreign lease, THAT invocation degrades to cold/no-epoch/read-only-ledger and announces it (stderr + --json) — never a blind merge. Epoch state is keyed per-session UUID, not per-cwd (a thread belongs to one prpt session by construction); the verify gate skips with reason when a foreign lease is live; single-writer-per-repo is documented as a stated --memory/--epochs limitation.

A24: Product port uses write-ahead ordering: an intent record (thread_id, expected turn index) is persisted BEFORE invoking codex; on startup, the sidecar's turn count is reconciled against the thread's on-disk rollout; disagreement => thread tainted => forced cut, ledger distiller runs over the rollout's orphan turn (transcript is on disk per the rollout schema), then proceed cold. A thread that fails reconciliation is never resumed — the crash window becomes one forced-cold turn instead of silent gauge/seen-set/ledger corruption.

A25: The decisive paired warm-vs-cold statistic gets an explicit pre-registered DATA CONTRACT: warm marginals computed from usage_cumulative_raw deltas EXCLUDING retry tokens (subtract the separately-recorded retry_input_tokens/retry_output_tokens — never eyeball the merged usage), excluding absorption turns (any turn following a censored same-epoch turn) and mode_mismatch turns, paired only against same-run pack-cold turns. Variant-level NATIVE_RESUME_ARMS gating is replaced with per-record usage_semantics/epoch_mode keys across aggregate_runs, reparse_timed_out_turns, and rebuild_native_delta_chain, with the mixed-mode (cold rows + delta rows in one run) reparse path unit-tested — the 'epoch-boundary-aware' promise now has named owners.

A26: Model discipline: CODEX_MODEL becomes MANDATORY for experiment arms so -m is passed on every fresh exec (seeds, cold turns, and cold retries); the actual model is extracted per turn from the on-disk rollout envelope where the pinned CLI exposes it, recorded as the codex analogue of _extract_primary_model, and the cross-arm model guard is extended to fail a run on intra-run model mixture. If the pinned rollout does not expose it, the spec's claim is explicitly downgraded to 'codex model equality enforced by version pin + env only' with per-run codex --version equality as the enforcement proxy.

A28: Gate-unavailable product mode made first-class: when the verify gate is structurally unavailable (non-pytest framework), the memory layer (a) freezes MAX_CONTRACTS eviction of ACTIVE contracts (the tombstone valve is closed, so growth-only pathology must not evict protections), (b) announces 'memory running UNVERIFIED (no supported test runner)' on stderr/--json every turn, and (c) release claims are scoped to pytest repos explicitly; gate-skip rate becomes a tracked per-run metric now.

risks.risk: Stage-B displacement bet fails behaviorally: codex re-reads files anyway (the pack's own re-read escape hatch invites double-checking), so the pack's ~4-6k/turn face-value cost plus its m-fold ride in totals is paid without displacing exploration — Stage B misses its token gates.
risks.mitigation: 1-run pilot (~5% of experiment cost) before the N=5x2 commit; kill-gate re-based on exploration-bytes (first-feed tool-output tokens, -30%) which measures the displaced quantity directly; strict pre-registered rejection lands the program on the incumbent 3/3-green cold loop with Stage A correctness improvements already shipped.

risks.risk: The warm-cache assumption is structurally dead under production pacing: OpenAI-side prompt-cache retention is minutes-scale, harness inter-turn gaps are 10-20+ minutes (turn wall + gate pytest + SLM calls), and F1's thin ~5-13k warm edge may already BE the TTL-degraded reality — leaving Stage C no headroom at all.
risks.mitigation: The pacing-faithful TTL curve + thread-longevity probe runs BEFORE any Stage C build; Stage 0's kill-before-build criterion cancels epoch.py if projected residual saving cannot cover probe+experiment spend; the ttl_expired cut rule caps the damage of any residual misses; program value is concentrated in Stages A+B, which are warmth-independent.

risks.risk: Stage 0 simulation infidelity: the F1 logs are N=3, no-pack, and the pack changes turn dynamics (tool calls, retries, gate outcomes), so the simulated epoch schedule, warm fraction, and displaceable/warmth-addressable decomposition are approximations that could green-light a Stage C the real Stage-B dynamics would kill.
risks.mitigation: Stage 0 gates are KILL-ONLY: they can cancel Stage C but can never substitute for its probes or experiment; the epoch-schedule simulation is re-run on the fresh Stage-B artifacts (which have identical instrumentation) before epoch.py is written, making the final build gate pack-conditioned.

risks.risk: The hardened risk gate (guard_hits>=1 forces cold + DESTRUCTIVE_KW + epoch-scope union for referential turns) may shrink the realized warm fraction below usefulness on contract-dense chains — epochs exist but almost never run.
risks.mitigation: This is the designed degradation direction (falls to the cold champion, never below it); the Stage-0/Stage-B simulation makes the post-hardening warm fraction a measured pre-build number rather than a surprise; the cut_reason histogram prices any future re-litigation of the threshold with data instead of argument.

risks.risk: Even margin-adjusted gates may be undecidable at N=5: F1 cold uncached already spans ~±5% at N=3, and a point estimate landing in the CI-straddle zone forces a judgment call the pre-registration was meant to remove.
risks.mitigation: Variance estimated from the existing N=5 artifacts BEFORE gate registration; decision rule requires point estimate + 90% CI upper bound; the ambiguous band has a pre-declared outcome (pack ships opt-in, epoch track closes); exactly one pre-committed N-bump (N=7) on the decisive metric — no open-ended re-runs.

risks.risk: codex CLI drift mid-program: resume flag set, usage semantics, item.completed types, rollout envelope, thread TTL/GC, and the compaction cliff/signature have all drifted historically; desktop/npm auto-updates can flip any of them between runs and silently invalidate probes or counters.
risks.mitigation: codex --version equality hard-asserted before every run (abort, never fall back); semantics calibration probe + cliff re-measurement re-run on any version change; item-type histogram makes counting drift visible as new types; semantics fingerprints in summary.json block mixed-fingerprint aggregation; warmth-evidence checks catch resume-behavior drift as mode_mismatch rather than silent cold.

risks.risk: F8 resolves badly: ChatGPT quota weighs cached reads at or near full price, so warm epochs drain finite user quota 2-3x faster per turn regardless of the uncached ledger — a product-killing property.
risks.mitigation: Quota-drain probe promoted to BEFORE Stage C build (not before ship); epochs remain one env flag from OFF and self-disabling in the product; the ship decision is keyed to whichever of total/uncached the probe shows actually drives quota; Stage B's total-led win is quota-safe either way.

risks.risk: Windows orphan-process reaping and quiescence polling are finicky: the reaper can miss grandchildren or the bounded wait can stall runs, and a missed orphan still contaminates the tree under the pack's authoritative 'current as of this turn' framing.
risks.mitigation: The never-resume-a-timed-out-thread rule is unconditional, so thread correctness never depends on the reaper succeeding; bounded wait + orphan_detected flag per turn; contaminated turns are dropped from the paired statistic; the pack directive retains the re-read escape hatch so a hash-stale excerpt is recoverable by the agent.

risks.risk: Complexity budget: hardened Stage C now carries four probes, evidence verification, circuit breakers, locks, and write-ahead reconciliation — the program could stall in scaffolding and never ship the parts that carry value.
risks.mitigation: Strict stage ordering with independent shipping: Stage A (correctness) and Stage B (pack) deliver the headline value with none of the Stage C machinery; every Stage-C artifact sits behind a free (Stage 0) or cheap (probe) kill-gate, so abandonment is inexpensive at every point and pre-declared as an acceptable outcome.

risks.risk: Deterministic removal-intent matching for deprecate ops has false negatives (paraphrased or implicit removal requests), so tombstones under-fire, legitimately-removed contracts stay active, and the guard nags about intentionally deleted names.
risks.mitigation: Under-firing is the safe direction (guard noise, not destructive amnesia); the names-only tombstone list is cheap to carry; deprecate-op proposal vs acceptance rates are logged so matcher recall becomes a measured number; revisit the matcher only with that data.

risks.risk: The 'unfinished' WIP key is a new SLM-authored narrative channel injected into seed prompts — hallucinated or stale WIP could anchor a fresh seed onto phantom tasks (a milder cousin of the anchoring the design rejects elsewhere).
risks.mitigation: Bounded size, overwrite-not-merge each turn (cannot accrete), injected on seed turns only, rendered as unverified narrative ('the previous session reported...'), and never consumed by guard/gate/tombstone logic — it informs the agent, it never gates the machine.

risks.risk: Stage A's collect-only pre-validation and second gate invocation add wall time to guard-hit turns, lengthening inter-turn gaps and thereby degrading exactly the warm-cache retention Stage C depends on (Stage A/Stage C interaction).
risks.mitigation: One batched collect-only call per turn, second invocation only when survivors exist; the added latency is measured in Stage A and fed into the pacing-faithful TTL probe so Stage C's economics are evaluated at the true post-Stage-A pacing, not the pre-Stage-A one.

spec.title: with_memory v2 — PACK+EPOCH/RG-H (red-team hardened): working-set pack on the proven cold backbone + evidence-verified, risk-gated, delta-injected micro-epochs over an externalized tombstoned ledger, all behind free offline kill-gates
spec.summary: Keep the F1-validated always-cold loop as the backbone and attack the measured dominant cost (F4 re-exploration) with a mechanical, fresh-from-disk working-set pack (Stage B); only then layer short warm codex micro-epochs (Stage C) whose warmth is a revocable, EVIDENCED privilege: guard-hit or destructive-surface turns categorically never run warm, every warm label is verified against thread_id + cached-token evidence, cuts are cheap (not 'free' — seed premium and WIP continuity are priced and engineered) because all durable memory (ledger + guard + gate + a bounded WIP record) lives outside the thread. Correctness is upgraded arm-independently first (Stage A): guard-hit contracts' locking tests actually RUN in the verify gate as a separate, collection-prevalidated invocation (the run9 recall-into-action fix, hardened against SLM-hallucinated node-ids), retry prompts quote the endangered contract, the ledger gains user-intent-conditioned quarantined tombstones and repair-aware/censored-aware distillation ordering, and the distiller records DONE not ASKED. NEW Stage 0 mines the F1 artifacts already on disk to decide — for zero tokens — whether Stage C is worth building at all. Every stage has a pre-registered, noise-margined kill gate with a pre-declared ambiguous-band outcome; every failure mode, including SLM outage and codex CLI drift, degrades fail-closed onto the measured 3/3-green cold configuration.
spec.architecture:
CACHE-MECHANICS FRAME (from the fact sheet, non-negotiable): F2 kills prefix discipline for anything we inject into a cold `codex exec` — a per-invocation turn_id UUID sits before user content, so only codex's ~5k preamble ever cache-hits cold. Two levers exist on codex: (L1) shrink cold turns by removing the agent's need to re-explore (F4: 12-52 tool calls/turn re-reading files; that content is uncached at first feed AND re-read by every subsequent intra-turn model call, multiplying totals m-fold), and (L2) genuine warm threads via `codex exec resume`, whose total cost grows ~quadratically toward the ~233k compaction cliff (F3) while its measured uncached edge over NO-PACK cold is only ~5-13k/turn — an edge that (i) overlaps the pack's own savings pool (both harvest F4) and (ii) may already be TTL-degraded, since real inter-turn gaps are minutes-long. Therefore: the backbone stays ALWAYS-COLD; the pack is the primary lever; epochs are a bounded, gated optimization that must first survive a free offline simulation (Stage 0), then pacing-faithful probes, then its own paid A/B against PACK-cold — and whose warmth must be evidenced per turn, never assumed.

FIVE LAYERS on the existing stack (B:/LLM/prpt/memory.py ledger+guard, B:/LLM/prpt/verify.py gate, harness B:/LLM/.claude/worktrees/intelligent-turing-a12c6b/research/chain_test_v2.py):

L(-1) — STAGE 0, OFFLINE DECISION LAYER (new, zero tokens): research/stage0_mine_f1.py replays the full EpochPolicy against the F1 per-turn logs on disk (guard_hits, retries, refactor class, gate outcomes, cumulative counters are all recorded): (a) simulated epoch schedule under the hardened risk gate — build gate: mean epoch length >=3 warm turns AND warm fraction >=40%; (b) decomposition of cold uncached into pack-displaceable re-exploration vs residual warmth-addressable; (c) warm total-vs-ctx curve + max single-turn thread growth -> calibrated ceiling; (d) kill-before-build: projected residual warm saving x simulated warm turns must exceed probe+experiment spend. Any miss cancels Stage C before a line of epoch.py exists.

L0 — CORRECTNESS SPINE, UPGRADED (Stage A, ships regardless of everything else). (a) Guard-test targeting, hallucination-hardened: memory.guard_test_targets(ledger, raw, spec) returns guard-hit contracts' `tests`; candidates are pre-validated via one batched `pytest --collect-only -q --continue-on-collection-errors` (SLM-authored node-ids like 'tests/test_timeouts.py::test_x' where the function doesn't exist are the EXPECTED case — _slm_extract_contracts never sees the test files); survivors run as a SECOND pytest invocation so targeting failures can never mask or disable the base _GATE_K scope (chain_test_v2.py:599); rc=4 maps to targeting-invalid (tri-state: not red — no retry burn; not green; base scope unaffected); UNRESOLVED count logged per turn. (b) build_retry_prompt gains the endangered contract text — repairs become contract-directed. (c) TOMBSTONES, evasion-hardened: contracts gain status active|deprecated in merge_contracts (memory.py:180); a deprecate op requires (i) deterministic removal intent in the USER prompt/spec — agent narration can never deprecate, closing the delete-the-tests-then-narrate-migration evasion; (ii) this turn's gate GREEN; (iii) files/symbols overlap changed files; PLUS a one-turn quarantine (effective only after the NEXT gate-green turn, guard still fires meanwhile) and, if the turn deleted the contract's locking tests (checked vs the pre-turn snapshot_ledger), full-suite green is required, not scoped green. Deprecated contracts compress to a names-only '[intentionally removed — do NOT resurrect, restorable if wrong]' list EXEMPT from MAX_CONTRACTS (resolving the never-GC vs eviction contradiction), rendered under its own 400-char cap so it can never displace active contracts out of STATE_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS (_join_capped drops trailing lines — the PR#44 bug class). (d) DONE-not-ASKED distiller with REPAIR-AWARE ORDERING: on retry turns, update_ledger runs AFTER the retry loop (chain_test_v2.py:1224-1248 currently completes before record_to_memory at 1265) on the LAST retry's transcript + post-retry changed files — never the broken attempt's confident narration; censored turns get a mechanical no-SLM degraded record (git-diff-derived provisional stubs + 'stale as of turn N') instead of PR#44 #10's silent skip. (e) Contracts with empty `tests` render a one-char UNLOCKED marker; UNRESOLVED+UNLOCKED rates are Stage-A acceptance criteria. (f) The ledger gains a bounded 'unfinished' WIP key (same nano call, second JSON key, overwritten each turn) so cut-destroyed in-flight plan state has a distillation channel — _EXTRACT_INSTR (memory.py:221) deliberately excludes it today.

L1 — WORKING-SET PACK (Stage B, the big lever). New prpt/pack.py, pure mechanical, zero new SLM calls: build_pack(cwd, spec, ledger, last_changed, budget~4-6k tok). Candidates = spec.target_files ∪ guard_hits() contract files ∪ last turn's git-modified files; excerpts read FRESH FROM DISK at injection time after post-timeout quiescence is confirmed (see L3), windowed around contract symbols (reuse memory.py _mentions + _FILE_RE), each stamped with content hash + rel-path/line-range header, whole-line truncated (_join_capped pattern). Prepended after memory_prefix() with the anti-re-exploration directive keeping the re-read escape hatch. Per F2 this buys ZERO cache on codex — its win is displacement, and the kill metric is exploration-BYTES (first-feed tool-output tokens from the --json stream), not tool-call count (which counts only item.type=='command_execution', agentic_variety_test.py:305-310 — a single schema string with drift history). On claude-code the same pack becomes the STABLE first message of the two-message stream-json pattern (F5) and IS a cached prefix; provider split lives in the adapter.

L2 — RISK-GATED, EVIDENCE-VERIFIED MICRO-EPOCHS (Stage C, only if Stage 0 + Stage B + all probes pass). New prpt/epoch.py: deterministic EpochPolicy state machine, mode ∈ {COLD, WARM(thread_id, k, ctx_gauge, seen_set, last_warm_ts)}. Warm turns run `codex exec resume` via the existing plumbing (thread.started capture chain_test_v2.py:1179-1201). Warmth is a REVOCABLE PRIVILEGE with per-turn EVIDENCE: the stream's thread_id must equal the resume target AND cached_tokens must exceed the ~5k preamble floor, else mode_mismatch => forced cut + quarantine counter (the capture path fails silently to a cold fallthrough in run_codex, agentic_variety_test.py:130-149 — labels alone are untrustworthy). Risk gate (cheapest safe default): guard_hits>=1 forces cold — computed with impacted-files UNIONED with the epoch's cumulative changed-file set so referential turns inherit epoch scope — plus _is_refactor plus a DESTRUCTIVE_KW list (remove/delete/drop/deprecate/retire/strip/prune/clean up; REFACTOR_KW at memory.py:48-52 contains none of these) checked for the epoch gate only; SLM/normalizer unavailable => RISKY => cold. Warm turns use DELTA INJECTION with two hard exceptions: the full ledger_state_summary (<=1.8k) rides EVERY warm message (delta-ing it would re-create the recency decay the ledger exists to fix), and pack refresh excludes files whose hash change came from the thread's OWN edits (provenance from file_change events) — external changes inject hunk diffs. Context gauge = last raw thread-cumulative input_tokens reading, monotonicity-checked AND semantics-fingerprinted (a per-version 2-turn calibration probe distinguishes cumulative from per-invocation semantics — both are monotone on a warm thread, so monotonicity alone is structurally blind to the historical semantics flip). Gap-aware: elapsed since last warm turn > probe-measured TTL => cut (ttl_expired) rather than paying a cold-priced 'warm' turn.

L3 — EXTERNALIZED MEMORY MAKES CUTS CHEAP (not free): update_ledger runs after every turn in BOTH modes (repair-aware, censored-degraded per L0); the thread is a cache, never the memory — and when the distiller is DOWN, the policy knows the thread has temporarily BECOME the memory: ledger_ok=False streaks suppress all non-mandatory cuts and forced cuts append a mechanical fallback record. A cut = next turn cold with memory_prefix + pack + last memory_record line + (on seeds) the 'unfinished' WIP section; seed premium and post-cut re-exploration bump are priced in the token model. Verify-gate (deterministic pytest, F7) runs on every editing turn in both modes with an explicit tri-state (green/red/NO-SIGNAL); retries ALWAYS run cold; any cold repair forces a cut with re-distill-before-reseed encoded in the state machine. Post-timeout quarantine: rc=124 => reap codex orphan process trees + bounded-wait quiescence poll (rollout mtime + process table) before pack/gate/ledger/next turn; a timed-out thread is never resumed (timeout_orphan). Run-level circuit breaker: 2 consecutive zero-token/rc!=0 turns => abort INVALID (the desktop config.toml re-clobber produces exactly this signature mid-run); config.toml content-hash checked at run start, every cut, and before every warm turn.

spec.epoch_policy:
Default mode: COLD-with-pack (the Stage-B configuration). Codex only; claude keeps cold + F5 stable-prefix caching. The policy below only exists if Stage 0's simulation gate (mean epoch length >=3 warm turns AND warm fraction >=40% under THESE rules), the pacing-faithful cache probe, the semantics calibration probe, and the F8 quota probe all pass.

ENTER WARM (seed a thread) when ALL hold: (a) deterministic same-feature continuation — spec.intent==act, spec.scope==localized, spec.target_files overlap previous turn's changed files (SLM tie-break only on ambiguity, verdict logged); (b) previous turn's gate verdict GREEN (tri-state: NO-SIGNAL does not qualify) with no retry fired; (c) next turn passes the risk check below; (d) usage parsing healthy AND semantics fingerprint == calibrated-cumulative; (e) previous turn did not time out (timeout_orphan rule) and no orphan quarantine is active; (f) ledger_ok healthy (no active degradation streak); (g) config.toml hash unchanged since run start. Seed turn = fresh `codex exec` (with -m; CODEX_MODEL mandatory) with full memory_prefix + pack + last memory_record line + the 'unfinished' WIP section; capture thread_id.

RISK CHECK (forces cold, no exceptions, no context-threshold loophole): _is_refactor (memory.py:320) OR guard_hits>=1 — computed with impacted-files UNIONED with this epoch's cumulative changed-file set so referential turns ('do the same for the async client') inherit epoch scope — OR any DESTRUCTIVE_KW match (remove/delete/drop/deprecate/retire/strip/prune/clean up) in raw/spec OR SLM/normalizer unavailable (absence of signal = presence of risk). Consequence: warm turns have guard silence by construction; the only destructive regime ever exercised is the measured cold + front-placed-guard pair (0/10 tax). Any warm turn observed with guard_hits>=1 is a policy bug, asserted zero in Stage C.

STAY WARM while ALL hold: (1) ctx_gauge < CEILING — Stage-0-calibrated: min(total-optimal point on the warm total-vs-ctx curve weighted by measured quota semantics, measured cliff − max observed single-turn growth − 20k margin), expected ~100-120k, env PROMPTPILOT_EPOCH_CEILING; ctx_gauge = last raw thread-cumulative input_tokens, monotonicity-checked; parse failure => cut; (2) k < 4 (env-tunable; doubles as the schema-drift backstop); (3) next turn passes the risk check; (4) last gate verdict GREEN — tri-state: NO-SIGNAL (skip/rc=5/timeout/targeting-invalid) never satisfies this; a skipped-gate turn with nonempty git-modified files forces cut(unverified_edit), and after any warm turn a deterministic _git_modified_files check overrides the SLM route (modified files + non-editing route => gate runs anyway); AND no cold repair ran (cold repair => thread/tree divergence => cut even on green, with re-distill-before-reseed encoded in the state machine); (5) no compaction event in the stream (tripwire => cut + quarantine the run's correctness claim); (6) cumulative series monotone AND semantics fingerprint stable (drift => cut + cold-for-rest-of-run); (7) elapsed since last warm turn < probe-measured TTL (else cut, ttl_expired — never pay a cold-priced 'warm' turn); (8) previous warm turn's WARMTH EVIDENCE verified: stream thread_id == resume target AND cached_tokens > ~5k preamble floor (else mode_mismatch => cut + quarantine counter); (9) previous turn not timed out (timeout_orphan) and config hash unchanged. OPTIONAL EARLY-CUT HEURISTIC (asymmetric, may only SHORTEN): predicted next warm total m_hat*(ctx_gauge+g_hat) > 1.5x rolling mean of this run's own pack-cold turn totals => cut(marginal_cost_early).

CUT = cheap by construction, honestly priced: the ledger was updated every turn (repair-aware; mechanically stubbed on censored turns; suppressed-cuts + mechanical fallback records under ledger degradation), so no cut-time SLM call is on the critical path; the next turn runs cold with memory_prefix + pack + memory_record line, and seeds additionally get the 'unfinished' WIP section. Non-forced cuts (ceiling, k_max) PREFER turns whose gate is green and whose distillation reported nothing unfinished. Resume failure / thread loss auto-reseeds transparently (cut_reason=resume_failed|thread_lost) — but in the PRODUCT the first resume_failed sets sticky epochs_off (no reseed-thrash on ephemeral ~/.codex). Every turn logs epoch_mode ∈ {cold, warm_seed, warm}, ctx_gauge, cut_reason, mode_mismatch, orphan_detected — the policy is fully reconstructable AND falsifiable from run artifacts.
slm_roles: Prompt rewrite (existing v2 normalizer, unchanged; clarify-route guard PR#39 in place) — its spec.intent/scope/target_files are free inputs to the packer, risk check, and epoch policy; FAIL-CLOSED: normalizer failure classifies the turn RISKY (cold + full guard), never default-warm

Ledger distillation: update_ledger() one nano call per turn in BOTH modes (existing), upgraded to DONE-not-ASKED inputs, repair-aware ordering (post-retry transcript on repair turns — one extra nano call only there), the 'unfinished' WIP second key (overwrite-not-merge), and double-plus-intent-conditioned deprecate ops; on outage the policy suppresses non-mandatory cuts and mechanical fallback records replace it — the externalized memory that makes cuts cheap is allowed to be DOWN without the thread's contents becoming discardable
Pack ranking ONLY on candidate-set budget overflow (0-1 nano call/turn; mechanical selection first per the mech-vs-SLM chemistry lesson; delete the hook if overflow ~0)
Epoch-entry tie-break ONLY when the deterministic overlap rules are ambiguous (rare; inputs + verdict logged)

Explicit NON-roles: no SLM in the verify signal (F7's value is deterministic exit codes); no SLM-authored code in the pack (excerpts are disk bytes with content hashes); no cut-time SLM summarization on the critical path; no SLM cut/stay authority (advisory early-cut only, deterministic rules override both directions); no SLM authority over deprecation (user-intent match is deterministic; agent/SLM narration can never tombstone a contract); the 'unfinished' WIP text is narrative context for the agent only — never consumed by guard/gate/tombstone logic
spec.token_model:
All numbers vs F1 endpoints on chain_long-13/codex: always-cold 12.9M total / 1.19-1.30M uncached; always-warm 30.9M / 1.13M (the uncached FLOOR any warm scheme can approach). SLM side ~115-130k nano tok/run (F6 + repair-turn re-distillation calls) counted in every with-arm total. Lead with TOTAL (2026-06-17 decision); uncached reported separately as a range; never dollars on codex (F8).

STAGE 0: 0 tokens (offline mining of artifacts on disk). STAGE A (correctness grafts on the cold loop): <=1.02x total vs incumbent (collect-only pre-validation + a second scoped pytest invocation on guard-hit turns = wall-time not tokens; the deprecate/DONE/WIP fields ride the existing nano call; repair turns add one nano call). STAGE B (pack, always-cold): predicted total 0.65-0.85x (~8.5-11M) — the load-bearing behavioral bet, priced as ~4-6k injected/turn (uncacheable per F2) displacing ~15-30k/turn first-feed exploration output => net uncached saving ~10-25k/turn (predicted band 0.80-0.95x); the m-fold intra-turn re-read shrinkage drives the total. GATES ARE SET INSIDE THE BANDS with CI discipline (see experiment_plan): STRONG PASS total <=0.80x + uncached <=0.90x; MARGINAL 0.80-0.90x total ships pack opt-in and closes the epoch track. Kill metric = exploration-bytes -30%, checked first on a 1-run pilot. STAGE C (epochs on top of B) — priced HONESTLY against its true baseline: the warm edge must be re-measured against PACK-cold (the probes do this; the F1 5-13k edge was vs no-pack cold and overlaps the pack's savings pool), warm injected overhead = state summary (~0.4-1.8k, always) + delta'd contract bodies + externally-changed-only pack refreshes (thread-own edits excluded — on an editing chain hash-refresh would otherwise be refresh-always on exactly the biggest excerpts), seed premium = full injection (~6-9k) per seed, and the post-cut cold turn carries a measured (not assumed-zero) re-exploration bump. Pre-registered: uncached_C <=0.90x of Stage B AND total_C <=1.10x of Stage B (with the ceiling now CHOSEN partly for total-optimality from the Stage-0 curve, this is a real constraint, not a hope) AND the absolute claim vs always-warm stays >=2x better total. We do NOT promise to beat the 1.13M warm-native uncached floor by a margin — parity-to-modest-win is the honest Stage-C claim; the decisive statistic is the paired WITHIN-RUN warm-vs-cold marginal-uncached comparison computed under an explicit data contract (retry tokens excluded via the separately-recorded retry_* fields; absorption and mode_mismatch turns excluded; evidence-verified warm turns only).
spec.correctness_protections: (1) Mode-independent validated spine: ledger + additive-bias guard injected every turn in both modes; the full ledger_state_summary rides EVERY warm message (never delta'd — delta-ing it would re-create the recency decay the ledger was built to fix); update_ledger after every turn (repair-aware on retry turns; mechanical degraded stubs on censored turns), so no thread ever monopolizes state — and when the distiller is DOWN the policy KNOWS the thread is temporarily the memory: non-mandatory cuts suppressed, mechanical fallback records at forced cuts, ledger_degraded_turns surfaced. (2) Deterministic verify-gate on every editing turn in both modes with an explicit TRI-STATE (green/red/NO-SIGNAL): NO-SIGNAL never reads as green anywhere (stay-warm, tombstones, cut-quarantine); skipped-gate-with-edits forces unverified_edit cut; a deterministic git-modified check after warm turns overrides SLM route misclassification; retries ALWAYS cold; red-after-retry inside an epoch => immediate cut; any cold repair => cut + re-distill-before-reseed. (3) RISKY TURNS CATEGORICALLY NEVER WARM, with the category made wide enough: _is_refactor OR guard_hits>=1 (epoch-scope-unioned so referential phrasing can't slip past file matching) OR DESTRUCTIVE_KW (closing the REFACTOR_KW remove/delete/drop hole — F3's catastrophe class and F1's builtin crash-bug run were destructive turns in warm threads) OR SLM-unavailable — so the 0/10 destructive-tax mechanism-and-regime pair (cold + front-placed full guard) is the ONLY destructive regime ever exercised; warm-turn guard silence is asserted, not hoped. (4) Recall→action mechanized SAFELY: guard-hit contracts' locking tests run in a SECOND, collection-prevalidated pytest invocation (hallucinated node-ids — the expected case for SLM-authored `tests` — degrade to base scope with an UNRESOLVED count, never to a silently disabled gate or a burned retry); retries quote the endangered contract; UNLOCKED/UNRESOLVED rates are Stage-A acceptance criteria, and a corrupted-tests fixture arm proves the degradation path. (5) Tombstones close the seed-resurrection hole WITHOUT opening the inverse channel: deprecation requires deterministic USER removal intent (agent narration can never tombstone), one-turn quarantine with guard still firing, pre-turn-snapshot check requiring full-suite green when locking tests were deleted (defusing the delete-the-evidence evasion), names-only rendering exempt from MAX_CONTRACTS under its own 400-char cap (active contracts can never be displaced or evicted by tombstones). (6) Compaction = corruption, not cost: calibrated ceiling (cliff − max single-turn growth − margin, re-measured per pinned codex version) + stream tripwire (cut + quarantine) + k<4 backstop + semantics-fingerprint calibration (monotonicity alone cannot detect the cumulative/per-invocation flip — both are monotone on a warm thread). (7) Warmth is EVIDENCED per turn (thread_id match + cached-token floor); mode_mismatch fails loudly into a cut + quarantine counter, so schema drift can never silently turn the experiment into cold-vs-cold or ship a no-op flag. (8) Pack staleness impossible by construction: excerpts read from disk AFTER post-timeout quiescence (rc=124 => orphan reap + bounded-wait poll; timed-out threads never resumed), hash-stamped, explicit re-read escape hatch; warm refresh keyed on EXTERNAL disk-hash change only. (9) Accounting integrity: prev_cum_raw reset at cuts with unit tests written FIRST; per-record usage_semantics/epoch_mode keys everywhere (no variant-level assumptions); the paired statistic's data contract excludes retry/absorption/mode_mismatch turns; runs are only counted when VALID (circuit breaker on dead turns, config-hash stability, version equality, ledger_ok >=12/13, mode_mismatch_rate=0). (10) Fail-safe degeneracy everywhere: resume failure, thread loss, ledger outage, parse drift, orphan contamination, lock contention, crash windows (product write-ahead reconciliation) — every path lands on cold-with-pack; cold-with-pack's own failure (Stage B gate) lands on the incumbent 3/3-green cold loop with Stage A shipped.
spec.per_provider_notes: CODEX (primary target): F2 means injected content NEVER prefix-caches cold — the pack is bought at face value every cold turn and must win by displacement; `codex exec resume` is the only cache channel and its usable warmth is now an EMPIRICAL question (pacing-faithful TTL probe) not an assumption. Usage is thread-cumulative on resumed turns (delta via delta_cumulative_usage, chain_test_v2.py:549; negative-delta fallback covers pre-2026-06-10 builds) BUT semantics are verified by the per-version calibration probe, not inferred. Enforcement, not aspiration: codex --version equality hard-asserted before EVERY run (run_codex resolves via shutil.which with no version check today; desktop/npm auto-update is live); CODEX_MODEL mandatory for experiment arms (-m on every fresh exec incl. seeds and retries; `exec resume` rejects -m — agentic_variety_test.py:140-146 — so warm-turn model is verified from the on-disk rollout envelope where the pinned CLI exposes it, and the cross-arm guard fails intra-run mixture; otherwise the claim downgrades explicitly to version-pin-as-proxy); ~/.codex/config.toml content-hashed at run start + re-verified at every cut and warm turn (desktop-app service_tier re-clobber mid-run produces the 2-consecutive-dead-turn signature the circuit breaker aborts on). rc=124 => orphan reaper + quiescence poll (grandchildren survive the direct-child kill for up to ~13 min per the reparse docs). F8: ChatGPT quota semantics for cached reads unknown => the quota-drain probe runs BEFORE Stage C build; epochs stay one env flag from OFF and self-disable in the product on first resume_failed. CLAUDE-CODE: cross-process prefix caching IS real (F5: 1h TTL, write 2x/read 0.1x) but ONLY via the two-message stream-json pattern — pack+ledger become the stable first message, volatile turn content the second; `claude -p --resume` reports per-invocation usage (no delta machinery); epochs DISABLED by default; DISABLE_MICROCOMPACT normalization already handled (_normalize_compaction_env). Native OTEL (claude_tap_internal_tool) is the eventual ground-truth token source for the claude arm; codex remains stream-parse-based with the calibration probe as its semantics anchor.

RUN-VALIDITY criteria (pre-registered; invalid runs excluded and re-run, never averaged): ledger_ok on >=12/13 turns; config hash stable; version equality; no unresolved orphan contamination; Stage C additionally mode_mismatch_rate=0 and zero native-compaction events.

GATE DISCIPLINE (from the Stage-0 variance estimate): every gate = point estimate AND 90% CI upper bound clear the threshold; exactly one pre-committed N-bump (to N=7) allowed on the decisive metric; every ambiguous band has a pre-declared outcome — no re-run discretion.

STAGE A VALIDATION (cheap): unit tests + seeded three-arm micro-fixture (destructive-kwarg turn and run9-class additive-but-buggy turn must go red at the causing turn with contract-quoting retries; corrupted/hallucinated `tests` arm must degrade to base scope, never to skip or spurious retry) + N=3 chain_auth smoke; accept iff total <=1.02x incumbent, no new gate-skip regressions, UNRESOLVED and UNLOCKED rates reported. Stage A rides in BOTH Stage B arms.

STAGE B (pack): 1-run pilot first (abort cheap on re-grep-anyway). Control = with_memory cold loop + Stage A; treatment = + pack. Metrics: total, uncached, contract-green via score_endstate + classify_run, destructive-tax and additive-but-buggy incidents separately, wall-time, exploration-bytes/turn (kill metric, -30% pre-registered), item-type histogram stability, median tool_calls (corroboration only), verify retries, UNLOCKED/UNRESOLVED rates, pack overflow rate, rendered-prefix tokens. PRE-REGISTERED: STRONG PASS iff total <=0.80x AND uncached <=0.90x AND green >=4/5 with zero destructive-tax AND exploration-bytes down >=30% => pack accepted, epoch track proceeds. MARGINAL (total 0.80-0.90x, green parity, no destructive tax) => pack ships opt-in, epoch track CLOSED. Otherwise REJECT => STOP; Stage A still ships.

STAGE C (epochs; runs only if Stage 0 gates + Stage B STRONG PASS + all three probes passed + pack-conditioned re-simulation passed): control = with_memory_pack; treatment = with_memory_v2, same window, N=5 each. PRE-REGISTERED: epochs ACCEPTED iff uncached_C <=0.90x uncached_B AND total_C <=1.10x total_B AND green parity (>= B's class distribution, zero destructive-tax, zero catastrophic) AND zero native-compaction events AND mode_mismatch_rate=0 AND every cut carries a logged cut_reason. SECONDARY (mechanism, confound-free, explicit DATA CONTRACT): paired WITHIN-RUN comparison — evidence-verified warm-turn marginal uncached (from usage_cumulative_raw deltas, retry_* tokens subtracted, absorption turns [any turn after a censored same-epoch turn] and mode_mismatch turns excluded) < the same run's pack-cold-turn mean uncached; per-position-in-epoch uncached must decline after the seed; per-position contract-regression readout alongside. Failure => ship Stage B only (pre-declared acceptable). Reference: builtin warm-native N=3 (30.9M/1.13M) as labeled cross-round context only. PARALLEL CHEAP: claude mini-probe (N=3, two-message stable-prefix pack vs identical single-message; accept iff >=50% of pack tokens cache-read by turn 3).
